observations: Industrial sewing machine with 'Emel' branding on the head and table.
Model 'EM 5000' is visible on the machine head in photo 0 and photo 1.
The machine is mounted on a white metal table with a red foot pedal.
A pink measuring tape hangs from the machine head.
The machine is shown in a workshop or garage environment with various tools and accessories.
A box labeled 'CLUTCH MOTOR' is visible under the table in both photos.
The machine appears to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible structural damage.
